title: The Antipodes of $q$-Quasi-Symmetric Functions and Non-Commutative Quasi-Symmetric Functions
summary: We prove the antipode formula for the $q$-deformations of quasi-symmetric functions. We also define a fundamental basis for non-commutative quasi-symmetric functions, and establish a partial antipode formula there. Our method also reduce to a new proof for the known antipode formula on the usual quasi-symmetric functions.
